source: The owner's program: a discovery call and 12 sessions over about three months; block lists proposed by the builder (MR-053)
urgentKinds: Something due or overdue within 7 days

urgentBlock.name: The urgent thing

questions.text: Tell me what is going on.

outputs: notes, the relevant room opened, a step

words.deeper: Going deeper here; {block} moved to next time
words.protect: Time to land it: on to your three steps
words.ahead: There is room for one more: {block}
words.behind: Running long; the rest of today moves to next time
words.urgent: Today is about {thing}; everything else moves to next time

sessions.name: Discovery call
sessions.goal: Hear her story in her words and leave with a first draft.

blocks.name: Her story

questions.text: What made you reach out now?

outputs: why now, her words

blocks.name: The snapshot
outputs: name, age, city, work, household, money in rough numbers

blocks.name: Money stress

questions.text: On a scale of one to ten, how stressed do you feel about money right now?

outputs: the first stress score

blocks.name: What would be different
outputs: goals in her words

blocks.name: The first draft
outputs: the summary sheet, the email

sessions.name: Get the picture and first accounts
sessions.goal: Her gut on every area, her debts in ranges, and the first two accounts open before we hang up.

blocks.name: Check-in and urgent check

questions.text: How are you doing with money this week? Anything on fire?

outputs: the urgent flag, or a clear start

blocks.name: Close open loops

questions.text: Last time you were going to look at a few things. How did it go?

outputs: homework marked done, parked items picked up

blocks.name: Today's plan
outputs: the session goal said aloud

blocks.name: Confirm

questions.text: Let us start with what you told me. Still right?

outputs: what she said, confirmed or corrected; guesses swapped

blocks.name: Housing and roommate

questions.text: About how much goes to your home each month, and is that your part or the whole bill?
Whose name is on the lease?
Do you have a car?

outputs: rent and share, lease, car or no car

blocks.name: Gut lap

questions.text: Without looking anything up: about how much goes to {area} each month?

outputs: a gut figure for every area

blocks.name: Debt check

questions.text: Roughly, what do you owe in total? A range is fine.
And what goes to those debts each month, the minimums?

outputs: debt ranges, minimums

blocks.name: First accounts
outputs: tracking app linked, high-yield savings open with buckets named after her goals

blocks.name: First picture
outputs: one card: what a month costs, the cushion target, the first draft of her FI number

blocks.name: Dream lap

questions.text: Forget what it costs now. What would you want to spend on {area}?

outputs: a dream figure for every area

blocks.name: Confirm the 401k match

questions.text: Does your employer match your 401k, and up to how much?

outputs: the match, confirmed

blocks.name: Roommate worst case
outputs: the if-it-all-falls-on-you card

blocks.name: Close a forgotten account

questions.text: Is there an old account you have not looked at in a while?

outputs: the account named and a step to close or move it

blocks.name: Three steps
outputs: three steps, some already done today

blocks.name: Close and book

questions.text: How satisfied are you with where your money is going right now, one to ten?
When works for next time?

outputs: the satisfaction score
the next date, the snapshot, the follow-up email
